"No representation on the appellant's side on call.
Having filed the appeal with delay of more than 700 days, the appellant at least would have been diligent in pursuing the matter.

4.
Even then, the appellant did not choose to pursue the matter.
Therefore, the appeal is dismissed for NC: 2025:KHC-D:15076 HC-KAR non-prosecution and consequently, I.A. No.1/2016 is also dismissed.
